featured_reviews.name: Huda Patanwala
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been a regular at their store. Bought some pieces during my last visit to India. My mom is visiting so she went to get some pieces for me this year. I also told my friends here about their clothes and quality, and they also wanted to place orders. Their clothes are decent and good quality. A little overpriced, but I would think they charge for the quality so that’s okay.

But my parents had the worst experience. If I was there I would have gone to the store to talk to the owner! The tailor outside is extremely rude and the owner supports him completely!

My parents bought two pants for me and asked the tailor to attach some extra fabric in the fork. The guy who works there said you have to pay 100. After waiting for 45 mins the tailor comes to my parents and asks for another 50Rs more. And in an extremely rude way. Almost yelling at my mom! The owner just sat there and saw all this. What is worse is that he ABUSED my parents as they walked out of the store! Like used VULGAR LANGUAGE!

Never would I recommend anyone to step foot in this store. I had high respect for the owner, but turns out he is okay with his staff and people he works with abusing people! If it’s your store, you try to make sure people are not ABUSED there at least! Especially WOMEN!

YOUR CLOTHES ARE NOT WORTH MY PARENTS DIGNITY!

featured_reviews.name: maryam faridi
featured_reviews.review_text:
This brand is extremely disappointing and not customer-friendly at all. Their policies feel overly focused on making money rather than supporting customers. The sizing is highly inconsistent—kurtas and pants don’t follow any reliable standard, so you simply can’t trust what you’re ordering.
On top of that, they charge for returns and exchanges, and instead of refunding your money, they issue coupons—essentially holding your money hostage. Their claim of “hassle-free returns and exchanges” is misleading; the entire process is complicated, frustrating, and full of unnecessary hurdles.
Overall, the products are expensive and not worth the trouble. It feels like a trap where customers end up losing money. This kind of approach only leads to dissatisfaction and distrust. I would strongly advise others to avoid buying from them.

featured_reviews.name: Saman Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I came in specifically asking for the the printed modal hijab. And I was told by the lady present at that time that they are left with just one. I asked her to show it to me and she handed it over to me. While I was checking the quality I asked her whats the price she said 750. I asked her if there are some plain ones she said yes and showed me some. I decided to take the printed one and we Gpayed 750 and she then told me that its for 1200 and 750 was for plain ones. I felt that was really misleading. I ended up paying 1200 but I think its way over priced. I live in North American and I get these printed Modal hijab for the same price, it would even be better quality. I found some other online stores in india selling it for 800, i just didnt have enough time to order it. Also after getting it I spoke to my cousin who lives there, she said same thing happened to her she bought couple of things and ended up with a bill of 7k, and then decided to never visit the place again. Also, everytime you buy things the seller is quite insisting of google review, happened with me and my cousin too. So Dont trust all of these reviews blindly. Visit and experience yourself. But according to me its overpriced!

Also, as a marketeer, I can Guarantee majority of thesereview are pure SEO coded marketing.

featured_reviews.review_text: I visited this shop today, and I wish I hadn't gone in the first place. There is no 50% sale; it's just a scam. We asked the staff to switch them on, but even after our request, they only turned on one fan, which didn't make a difference. featured_reviews.name: Imtiaz Danawala
featured_reviews.review_text:
Poor Product Quality & Unfair Exchange Policy.

I purchased a T-shirt for ₹1200, and after just one wash, the color started bleeding. When I raised this issue at the store, I was told their resolution process takes 15 days, while other branded stores and online offer instant exchanges or refunds for defective products.

To make things worse, They had offered exchange only within the same brand, with just two color choices available. When I finally took the exchange, the new T-shirt was also defective—its text started peeling off!

This shows a serious lack of quality control and poor customer service. If you're spending this much on a T-shirt, you'd expect better durability and a hassle-free return policy.

Definitely I do not recommended!
